Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: CREATING AND EXECUTING Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Le
Topic 1.1: Wind Musical Instruments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Wind Musical Instruments
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is the importance of indigenous wind instruments in Kenyan communities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify indigenous wind musical instruments from Kenyan communities
2. explain the role of the parts of a wind instrument in sound production
3. care for an indigenous Kenyan musical wind instrument
4. draw a wind instrument using crayon etching technique
